description: Safety-critical embedded decomposed. V-model development, requirements traceability, MISRA C rules, static analysis, certified RTOSes, AUTOSAR, FMEA + FTA, hardware diagnostic coverage, safety case construction.

sub_mechanisms.name: V_model_development
sub_mechanisms.definition: Requirements → architecture → design → code (left of V). Unit test → integration → system → acceptance (right).
sub_mechanisms.why: Each left side has corresponding test on right. Bidirectional traceability. Standard for DO-178C, ISO 26262.

sub_mechanisms.name: requirements_traceability
sub_mechanisms.definition: Every requirement traces to design + code + test. Every code element traces back.
sub_mechanisms.why: Auditors verify completeness. No code without requirement = dead code. No requirement without test = unverified. Tools (DOORS, Polarion) enforce.

sub_mechanisms.name: MISRA_C_rules
sub_mechanisms.definition: Forbid recursion, dynamic alloc, gotos, multiple returns. ~150 rules. MISRA-C:2012 current.
sub_mechanisms.why: Eliminate undefined behaviour + risky constructs. Static analysis enforces. Standard automotive + aerospace.

sub_mechanisms.name: static_analysis_tools
sub_mechanisms.definition: Polyspace, Coverity, LDRA, CodeSonar. Detect undefined behaviour, dead code, MISRA violations.
sub_mechanisms.why: Catches bugs before runtime. Mathematical reasoning about all paths. Required for certification.

sub_mechanisms.name: structural_code_coverage
sub_mechanisms.definition: Statement coverage, branch coverage, MC/DC (Modified Condition/Decision Coverage).
sub_mechanisms.why: DO-178C Level A requires MC/DC. Each condition in boolean expression independently exercised. Drives test design.

sub_mechanisms.name: AUTOSAR_classic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Automotive Open System Architecture. Layered SW: BSW (basic), RTE, application. Standard interfaces.
sub_mechanisms.why: Industry standard for ECUs. Decouples app from MCU specifics. Cost: complexity, conformance. Used by every automotive OEM.

sub_mechanisms.name: AUTOSAR_adaptive
sub_mechanisms.definition: Adaptive AUTOSAR. POSIX-based for high-performance (ADAS, infotainment). Service-oriented.
sub_mechanisms.why: Classic too rigid for high-compute. Adaptive: Linux + middleware. Used in autonomous driving stacks.

sub_mechanisms.name: FMEA_failure_mode_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Failure Mode + Effects Analysis. Systematic enumeration of failures + consequences.
sub_mechanisms.why: Drives requirements: 'what if sensor X dies?'. Catches scenarios not from happy path. ISO 26262 requires.

sub_mechanisms.name: fault_tree_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: FTA: top-down analysis. Top event → contributing failures combined via AND/OR.
sub_mechanisms.why: Quantify failure probability. Identify single points of failure. Complementary to FMEA (which is bottom-up).

sub_mechanisms.name: diagnostic_coverage
sub_mechanisms.definition: Fraction of failures detected by diagnostics. Higher = better safety integrity.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hardware DC contributes to SIL/ASIL. CRC on flash, EDAC on RAM, signature monitoring. Per-component analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: safety_case
sub_mechanisms.definition: Structured argument that system is acceptably safe. GSN (Goal Structuring Notation).
sub_mechanisms.why: Demonstrates safety reasoning to regulators. Top goal → sub-goals → evidence. Standard for certification.

sub_mechanisms.name: certified_RTOS
sub_mechanisms.definition: RTOS pre-certified for DO-178C / ISO 26262. SafeRTOS (FreeRTOS variant), VxWorks Certified, PikeOS.
sub_mechanisms.why: Certifying own RTOS infeasible. Use pre-certified + leverage their evidence. Cost: licensing $$$.

derivation_rules.name: MISRA_compliance_required_for_ASIL_C_D
if: software is ASIL C or D
then: MISRA C compliance is effectively required
derivation_rules.why: MISRA eliminates undefined behaviour + risky constructs. Auditors expect. Static analysis tools verify. Standard practice.

derivation_rules.name: MC_DC_for_DO_178C_Level_A
if: software is DO-178C Level A (catastrophic failure)
derivation_rules.why: Each condition in boolean expression must independently affect outcome. Stronger than branch coverage. Drives test design for safety-critical avionics.

derivation_rules.name: certified_RTOS_saves_certification_effort
derivation_rules.why: Certifying RTOS from scratch: years + millions. Pre-certified: leverage existing evidence. Standard buy-vs-build choice for safety-critical.

derivation_rules.name: FMEA_drives_requirements_completeness
derivation_rules.why: Happy-path-only requirements miss failures. FMEA: 'sensor disconnected? short circuit? bias?'. Each becomes safety requirement. Standard ISO 26262.

derivation_rules.name: diagnostic_coverage_determines_SIL_ASIL
then: it qualifies for specific SIL/ASIL level
derivation_rules.why: ISO 26262 + IEC 61508 tables: SIL/ASIL determined by failure rate × coverage. Higher coverage = higher integrity. Standard certification path.
